Copy .env into place and update .gitignore.
Paths like /foo.env and compounds like .envrc stay untouched.
The file config.yaml sits beside settings.json.
Edit ~/.claude.json before touching .claude.json or .mcp.json.
Hidden configs like .eslintrc.json and .prettierrc.json narrate too.
Bare dotfiles such as .npmrc and .editorconfig are left alone.
